name: Haiku deep value
strategy: Sector rotation capturing energy outperformance and small-cap value momentum while maintaining moderate risk through cash buffer and disciplined position sizing.
reassessment_note: Initial tech mean-reversion thesis (TQQQ short at -17.41%) did not work as tech momentum persisted despite valuation concerns—QQQ up 25.76% YTD, TQQQ up 49.86%. Nasdaq-100 rally driven by Magnificent Seven capex on AI infrastructure shows no signs of rolling over. Pivoting to capture working themes: energy sector outperformance (+32% YTD with XLE at 62.04), small-cap value rotation (IWD/SPLV/KRE tier exposure), emerging market strength (EEM +3.44%), and financial sector resilience (XLF) amid steeper yield curve. Eliminated underwater TQQQ short; reduced cash from 39% to 30% to deploy capital into high-conviction working trades while maintaining defensive positioning. Maintains less than 50% overlap with Round 2 (only SPY and BTC commonality).

positions.thesis: Core broad-market equity beta; maintains S&P 500 index exposure as anchor holding while other positions provide sector tilt.

Energy Select Sector SPDR at $62.04. Energy outperformance structural (+32% YTD) driven by geopolitical tensions, supply constraints, and renewed demand. Sector has outpaced all S&P 500 segments; momentum remains intact.

iShares U.S. Small-Cap Value ETF at $251.93. Traditional value rotation catalyst as interest rates stabilize and growth expectations moderate. Currently down -0.31% from entry; mean reversion setup with cleaner fundamentals than mega-cap tech.

iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF showing strength (+3.44% on current leg). Emerging market valuations attractive relative to developed markets; rotation themes benefit from commodity strength and China stabilization.

Financial Select Sector SPDR at $54.84. Financials benefit from elevated yield environment and steeper yield curve; banking system resilience demonstrated through recent stress periods. Regional bank strength (KRE separate position) indicates sector health.

Invesco KBW Regional Banking ETF at $71.55. Concentrated play on regional bank outperformance; benefits from sticky deposits, loan growth, and rate environment. Currently -1.08% on leg; supports thesis on financial sector rotation.

Invesco S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF at $71.30. Complement to value tilt; provides downside protection and steady returns. Diversifies from high-beta energy/emerging markets positions while maintaining equity exposure.

Bitcoin spot exposure at $83,974. Maintains crypto allocation for portfolio diversification. BTC consolidating near all-time highs (+31.51% on current leg); moderate 3% allocation manages downside risk while capturing upside participation.
